test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 28 Nov, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question: Seven children - T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. U sits second to left of Z. Y sits third to the left of T. Only one child sits to the right of X. Only two children sit to the left of W. Who among the following children sits at the extreme left end of the row?
solution:
Given: Seven children - T, U, V, W, X, Y and Z - are sitting in a straight row, facing north. 

1) Only two children sit to the left of W.

2) Only one child sits to the right of X. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cf5f47b2604ace89cb71abbd90d5f38c1948ccacda970297cc1d23433c5090be.png] 

3) Y sits third to the left of T.

4) U sits second to left of Z.

After positioning Y, T, U and Z only one position is left which will be occupied by the only child left i.e. V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2c61a291dfcd610de14025bed77c3b07ded22d03d402412c3d0f07a8617036f9.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, Y among the following children sits at the extreme left end of the row.

Hence, "Option 2" is the correct answer.
